shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/medical/power/pipes/climate, stairs/ladders/elevators, opt-in vertical threats, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. DBH + VEF PipeSystem soft compat; Reverse Commands soft compat (reflection-only).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid mineable rock, thick-roofed, 12C.
- Animal policy (conservative): pets follow master, obedient pets get send gizmos, non-pen unrestricted pets cross for food; pen animals never.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x), grand staircase 2x2 (0.6x, quality scales climb), elevator (0.35x, power bridge, Extend gizmos, two-hop rides).
- Climb = 90t x type x quality x slider. All minifiable (uninstall collapses far side). Bomb >= 40 punches constructed rooftops. Giddy-Up mounted riders blocked.
- Stairs do NOT unroof anything below. Sky-side landing platforms (footprint+1) are RoofSurface, exempt from air-reversion while stairs stand.
- T9 VERTICAL UTILITY LINKS (Building_ABUtilityLink : Building_ABStairs, ext utilityOnly): full counterpart lifecycle (spawn far end, collapse together, landing pads) but never pawns - excluded inside NearestUsableStairs (all transport/migration consumers inherit it), no float menu, no climate exchange (sealed). AB_VerticalConduitUp/Down: Power tab, 20 steel, Electricity research, CompABPowerBridge (same battery-equalization comp as stairs). AB_VerticalWaterPipeUp/Down: patch-gated on DBH (PatchOperationFindMod), Hygiene tab, 15 steel, research mirrors DBH (Plumbing under dbhlitemode only), bridges DBH water nets touching its cell. ABPipeCompat routes per-def flags (bridgeWater/bridgeVef); VEF nets remain stairs-bridged only.
- Migration diagnostics: verbose-log lines at each TryTowards decision.

## Sky surface model (round-10 final 2026-07-19)
- Owned terrains: AB_OpenAir (see-through, impassable), AB_RoofSurface (corrugated steel, muted vanilla-toned), AB_MountainTop (walkable cap; visual comes from the overlay, texture is a fail-open fallback).
- COVERED-BELOW rule (LevelSync.CoveredBelow): constructed roof below, OR artificial impassable edifice supporting an adjacent constructed roof - steel to the OUTER wall edge. Roof events re-sync 8 neighbors; wall-only changes converge on the sweep.
- MOUNTAIN CAP RENDERING (SectionLayer_ABMountainCap): quads drawn with THE VANILLA FOG MATERIAL (MatBases.FogOfWar clones, fully-fogged vertex colors) so cap and real fog are pixel-identical and their boundary dissolves. Two queues derived at runtime: low for the body, high (cutout+1) for wall-facing rim tiles. Overlap-free 3x3 tiling; edifice-holding cells get a plain base quad. Regenerates on Terrain|Buildings flags; quads under unmined rock make mining reveal with no regen.
- MINED FLOORS: leave-terrain kept as mined marker; overlay fills those cells flat in the source rock's wall/edge color (LevelSync.TryGetMinedRockColor).
- Mountains: mass erodes one step to the walkable unfogged ledge; wall core solid rock + thick roof; fog deep interior only (radius-2 rule). Ore lumps in the mass (ABOreGen 6/10k, commonality-weighted).
- Sync self-heal: subscription retry (250t) + ReconcileRooftops (FinalizeInit + 2000t), platform-exempt, CoveredBelow-driven; natural roofs generation-time only.

## See-below renderer
- Static pass: lower map's section meshes via cloned materials in a runtime-derived queue band. Dynamic pass: ONE-WAY MIRROR - below things draw only if unroofed, unfogged, in view, under open air.
- Air-cells light mask (night cap 0.45); silhouettes suppressed; ceiling hints; far clip 70. Weather decider suppressed on pocket levels.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified in-game 2026-07-19)
- Logistics: outbound haul + inbound fetch + demand pull + export pinning + carried-cargo delivery. Column-aware stuff picker (transpiler + ResourceCounter augmentation).
- Needs: rest to owned bed anywhere in column or free bed on linked level; food redirect incl. eligible pets. Medical rescue three ways: (1) auto work-giver on victim's level (Doctor work, same-faction); (2) emergency work migration (TryMigrateForEmergencyWork: plausibility pre-check BEFORE cooldown, own 600t cooldown - vanilla caches emergency givers into a list the normal pass never scans); (3) assignment-free forced float-menu rescue (verified in-game). Capture via float menu. All ride CarriedIntent through StairTransfer.
- One-colony UI: tables append other levels; colonist bar ordered per column; level buttons in global controls; camera preserved; beds alert aggregated.
- Power/pipes/climate bridges per link; ABPendingOrders replay.

## T8 threat opt-ins (implemented, pending verification)
- DESIGN: never make pocket maps storyteller targets - divert already-fired surface incidents at execution. Pacing, points, cooldowns stay vanilla; only the battlefield moves. Both toggles default OFF + shared divert-chance slider (default 25%, shown only when a toggle is on).
- Infestations -> basement: prefix on IncidentWorker_Infestation.TryExecuteWorker mutates parms.target after validating InfestationCellFinder.TryFindCell on the basement (worker spawns with spawnAnywhereIfNoGoodCell false).
- Drop raids -> sky: prefix on TryResolveRaidSpawnCenter of the four drop arrival workers (Edge/Center/Random/EdgeDropGroups) - faction+strategy+mode already resolved, no spawn cell or pawns yet, so pods+letter+lord retarget in one stroke. Skips: quest raids (questTag/quest), preset spawnCenter, sieges, non-hostile factions; validates DropCellFinder.TryFindRaidDropCenterClose on the sky map.
- HOSTILE DESCEND AI (HostileDescend, guard hostileMove): 250t scan on pocket levels behind GenHostility.AnyHostileActiveThreatTo gate. Idle hostiles (null/wander/wait jobs) that are humanlike or mech, not in mental state, with NO reachable attack target (attackTargetsCache walk, max 8 CanReach probes, over-cap assumes reachable) take the stairs toward ground. StairTransfer releases them from their map-scoped lord before despawn (Notify_PawnLost ExitedMap) and on arrival joins the faction's existing LordJob_AssaultColony or starts one. Insects/animals/entities never cross (diverted infestation = self-contained basement fight). Giddy-Up mounted riders and mental-state pawns wait for a later scan.
- Guards: threats (diversion), hostileMove (descend + lord fixups).

## Performance architecture
- ABGuard plain-bool switches; AnySkyLevels static gate; NearestUsableStairsCached per-tick memo; shared stairs helpers. Recurring: weather 150t, pipes/climate 250t, power 10t hash, rooftop sweep 2000t, hostile scan 250t on pocket maps (one cheap lookup when calm). Zero recurring cost with no levels. Emergency migration pre-check allocation-free, cooldown charged only when plausible.

## Compat
- DBH + VEF bridges; Reverse Commands; Fluffy Animal Tab; Declutter UI; Giddy-Up; incompatibleWith MultiFloors + ZLevels1.1; RimThreaded unsupported; foreign pocket maps read as level-0.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Floating rim/cap cells on natural roof loss (rare); sky projectile dim over air; tall below-sprites clip at rooftop edges; wall-only edits converge on sweep cadence; mined-floor rim tint hard edges by design; bill radius vs stairs delivery; couples as singles in beds alert; RC direct links only; restaurants per-level; stuff picker direct links only.
- Multiple doctors can pile onto one cross-level emergency in the same window.
- T8: fleeing/kidnapping raiders on pocket levels cannot exit the map until they descend (caught by the idle scan after the mental state ends); mounted Giddy-Up raiders never descend; diverted basement insects do not resurface.
- T9: VEF nets bridge at stairs only (per-net vertical shafts would need per-mod research); vertical links can open a level like stairs do (stated in descriptions).

## Tranche plan
- T0-T10 DONE. Optimization + compat pass DONE. Playtest rounds 2-10 DONE. Round-11: float-menu rescue VERIFIED; emergency migration pending verification.
- T8 threat opt-ins + T9 vertical utility links: IMPLEMENTED 2026-07-19, compiling, pending in-game verification (divert with slider at 100%, descend AI, conduit power flow, DBH water pipe with companion mod).
- Next: verification relaunch, then T5 publishing prep. Backlog: T11 world integration, VEF per-net shafts.

## Status
T8 + T9 implemented and compiling. Verification relaunch needed: round-10 visuals, emergency rescue migration, threat diversion + descend AI, vertical links.
